applyTo: "ws-part1-github-copilot/labs/starter/**/*.py"

# Python instructions

- Support Python 3.10 or later and use type hints.
- Keep functions small and focused.
- Add or update pytest tests for behavior changes.
- Run Python and pytest commands from `ws-part1-github-copilot/labs/starter` using its local `.venv`.
- Do not add application dependencies.
